messages:
Priya (Support): Customer reported that their rerank call returns a single string of comma-separated scores instead of an array of numbers, and ordering looked wrong. They attached the curl they copied from the Console snippet.

Customer (pasted):
```bash
curl https://api.redwood.com/v1/rerank \
  -u $API_KEY: \
  -d '{"query":"best match","candidates":"opt1\nopt2\nopt3"}'
```

Priya (Support): They said they followed the example in Console -> Rerank and didn’t set Content-Type. HTTP 200 but body has: "scores": ["0.7,0.2,0.1"] which the client then turned into [0.7,0.2,0.1] incorrectly in some languages or into a single string in others. They’re blocked because they expect numbers.

Ben (SRE): Checked request id rnr-20260315-77 in logs. Service returned a single-element scores array with a CSV string. The pipeline parsing step treated the request body as form-data because Content-Type was absent and `-d` triggered application/x-www-form-urlencoded in curl. Legacy form parser concatenates newline-delimited candidates into one blob, new JSON-path expects array. This mismatch causes model scoring to collapse into a CSV blob.

Tom (Platform): Reproduced locally. Two distinct issues:
- Missing Content-Type -> server applies form parser which gives candidates as single string.
- Console had two old examples: one showing newline-delimited string and one showing JSON array. A stale example was cached in Console's static CDN, so users sometimes copy the wrong snippet.

Elena (Docs): Ouch. I accidentally left the old newline example in Console quickstart when we changed the API shape last quarter. Will remove it and make the recommended snippet explicit. Also add a note about shell quoting differences (bash vs powershell vs cmd.exe) because escaping newlines incorrectly is a common source of issues.

Priya (Support): Need an immediate workaround to send to the customer. Also want recommended cURL examples to include in the reply and update the docs.

Ben (SRE): Workarounds and repro scripts: I tested three variants.

1) What the customer used (problematic):
```bash
curl https://api.redwood.com/v1/rerank -d '{"query":"q","candidates":"a\nb\nc"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY"
```
Response: 200, body.scores = ["0.12,-0.45,0.98"]

2) Minimal fix: add Content-Type and an array of strings:
```bash
curl https://api.redwood.com/v1/rerank \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  --data-raw '{"query":"q","candidates":["a","b","c"]}'
```
Response: 200, body.scores = [0.12,-0.45,0.98] (numbers)

3) Preferred shape (array of objects):
```bash
curl https://api.redwood.com/v1/rerank \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  --data-raw '{"query":"q","candidates":[{"text":"a"},{"text":"b"},{"text":"c"}]}'
```
Notes: `--data-raw` avoids curl auto URL-encoding behavior in some shells. `-d` with no Content-Type can set application/x-www-form-urlencoded.

Tom (Platform): Added extra checks: when Content-Type is missing and body looks like JSON, we currently try form parsing first. Short-term mitigation: if body contains "candidates" and a \n, return 400 with message: "Ambiguous body format: include 'Content-Type: application/json' and send 'candidates' as JSON array." Filed issue: https://github.com/redwood/inference/issues/2471

Elena (Docs): Drafted reply and updated Console snippet. New recommended curl (cross-shell friendly):

Bash/macOS/Linux:
```bash
curl -sS https://api.redwood.com/v1/rerank \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  --data-raw $'{"query":"find best","candidates":["first","second","third"]}'
```
PowerShell (Windows):
```powershell
$body = '{"query":"find best","candidates":["first","second","third"]}'
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'https://api.redwood.com/v1/rerank' -Method Post -Headers @{Authorization="Bearer $env:API_KEY"; 'Content-Type'='application/json'} -Body $body
```
CMD.exe (Windows): recommend using a file to avoid quoting headaches:
```cmd
echo {"query":"find best","candidates":["a","b","c"]} > body.json
curl -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Authorization: Bearer %API_KEY%" --data-binary @body.json https://api.redwood.com/v1/rerank
```

Elena (Docs): Also added a callout: maximum 128 candidates. If you send >128, the request returns 400 with message "candidate limit exceeded: max 128". If candidates are provided as a single newline string it will be interpreted as 1 candidate which may skew scoring and produce unexpected single CSV-like score strings.

deploy-bot: docs-deploy: started for branch fix/rerank-console-examples commit 3f4b2a9 -> staging

Priya (Support): Sent the Bash snippet and PowerShell equivalent to the customer; asked them to retry. Also included explanation of why missing Content-Type causes a different parser to run.

Ben (SRE): Follow-up changes: added unit tests for form parser and JSON parser disambiguation, added regression that fails if examples with newline-delimited candidates slip back into Console. Created internal ticket INC-2026-0315-RERANK for monitoring.

Tom (Platform): Medium-term: update server to prefer JSON parsing if body starts with '{' or '[' even when Content-Type missing, but only after we add stricter validation and explicit 400 messages. Added to next sprint.

Priya (Support): Customer confirmed fix after adding Content-Type and switching to array shape. Scores returned as numeric array and ordering matched. Closing ticket and marking as resolved. :white_check_mark:

Elena (Docs): PR merged. I'll paste the PR link here once CDN finishes. Thanks team.
